phaseChanges: ADR-002: fee structure recalibrated 50 bps → 100 bps. SettlementHub carries PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS=100, OPERATOR_SHARE_BPS=70, TREASURY_SHARE_BPS=30.

ADR-003: SettlementHub deployed for the FIRST time. Adds trustless on-chain payment splitting (99% merchant / 0.7% operator / 0.3% treasury) with three pay paths: payIntent (approve+pay), payIntentWithPermit (EIP-2612), payIntentWithAuthorization (ERC-3009 gasless) + payIntentBatchWithAuthorization (MAX_BATCH_SIZE=50, x402 micropayments).

Deploy.s.sol updated: now deploys 4 contracts. SettlementHub receives the real guardian directly in its constructor (no transferGuardian dance — it has no init step requiring temporary deployer authority).

ERC-1271 smart-wallet support (PR #148 + #149): SettlementHub REDEPLOYED STANDALONE (forge create, NOT Deploy.s.sol — the other 3 contracts + the nodeit stake are untouched) to switch ERC-3009 settlement from receiveWithAuthorization(...,v,r,s) to the (...,bytes signature) overload, which USDC's SignatureChecker validates for BOTH EOA ECDSA and ERC-1271 contract wallets (Coinbase Smart Wallet). Old SettlementHub: 0x083182ea2b3ef0946f69a29c33d3597cec6043b3 (replaced; intents registered there are stranded — drained via expiry). New: 0xe2D6EaF23c285E827f37dC5Ec05fFfD860dBE0e1. Same constructor (usdc/treasury/guardian), same fee constants. ERC-6492 (counterfactual smart wallets) is Phase 2.

ADR-004: la autorizacion ERC-3009 queda atada a su intent (nonce == intentId) y el registro exige firma EIP-712 de un intentSigner inmutable, verificada con SignatureChecker (admite cartera normal y multisig ERC-1271). Corrige dos vulnerabilidades criticas de robo total por el nodeit.

ADR-004: sistema de disputas RETIRADO por completo. DisputeResolver ya no se despliega y StakeManager pierde slash(): el stake es fianza anti-Sybil, no confiscable. Cero eventos on-chain desde el despliegue original y sin cablear off-chain.
ADR-005: comision del protocolo 100 -> 150 bps. Reparto 70/30 intacto: 105 bps al nodeit, 45 bps al treasury. El comercio recibe el 98.5%.
intentSigner apunta a un Safe (ERC-1271) en vez de a una clave suelta: la direccion es inmutable, pero los firmantes se rotan por dentro sin redesplegar el hub.

Corte limpio: los TRES contratos se redesplegaron con Deploy.s.sol (no standalone). El ABI de SettlementHub cambia —registerIntent pasa a recibir un struct firmado— asi que el daemon viejo no habla con el contrato nuevo ni al reves. Contratos anteriores, ya reemplazados: SettlementHub 0xe2D6EaF23c285E827f37dC5Ec05fFfD860dBE0e1, NodeRegistry 0x67821b659d65a58f374b11e4657653bdf25f9a07, StakeManager 0x8f12bB8222fAe4dceCFd13cFdD7B2f0790207376, DisputeResolver 0x1d057bF2bDE68eC4006ea15Da0c2cF35584d9dfC (retirado, no se redespliega). Los intents registrados en el hub anterior quedan varados y se drenan por expiracion, y el stake del nodeit sigue en el StakeManager anterior: hay que registrar y estacar de nuevo.

roleSeparation.note: Deployer, treasury, guardian e intentSigner son CUATRO direcciones distintas. Deploy.s.sol revierte si dos coinciden. El deployer solo pago gas y no conserva autoridad. El intentSigner es un Safe: su direccion es inmutable en el hub, pero sus propietarios se rotan por dentro.

previousDeploys.reason: Pre-SettlementHub deploy (PR #61 era). Orphaned by Phase B5 redeploy: SettlementHub didn't exist yet, and the fee structure was 50 bps (ADR-002 raised it to 100 bps). Phase B5 redeploys all four contracts together so the auditor sees a single coherent deploy.

Tanda C contract fixes deploy (PR #44). Orphaned by depositFor refactor (PR #61) — StakeManager.initialize signature changed and NodeRegistry constructor lost the usdc param, making the on-chain ABI incompatible with the new code.

First deploy with role separation (PR #20). Orphaned after tanda C contract bug fixes (PR #44) — required redeploy because StakeManager constructor now takes treasury (slash transfers there) and DisputeResolver._executeSlash now slashes 20% instead of 100%.
Redeploy with adjustable minStake=40 USDC (PR #15). Orphaned after role-separation redeploy — deployer + treasury + guardian were the same wallet (audit finding C1).
Initial deploy with hardcoded MIN_STAKE=100 USDC. Orphaned after adjustable-minStake refactor (PR #14).

orphanedStake.note: The bootstrap nodeit had 40 USDC staked in the Phase B5-orphaned StakeManager (0xD365...E198). Recoverable via requestWithdrawal() + 7-day timelock + executeWithdrawal(). The nodeit re-stakes 40 USDC fresh into the new StakeManager (0x8f12...7376) as part of Phase B5 re-registration.

notes: Phase B5 testnet deployment (ADR-002 + ADR-003). FOUR contracts now: StakeManager, NodeRegistry, DisputeResolver, SettlementHub. SettlementHub is the trustless on-chain settlement layer — replaces the prior 'operator-side daemon forwards funds' trust model with atomic on-chain splitting. Fee structure: 100 bps total (0.7% nodeit / 0.3% treasury). ERC-3009 gasless payments supported (payer signs off-chain, nodeit submits + pays gas). Adjustable minStake=40 USDC, FOUR separated wallets. Operator registration is a 3-tx flow: usdc.approve, stakeManager.deposit, nodeRegistry.register. External audit pending before mainnet — see audits/SCOPE.md (~2,758 LoC in scope).
